title: Evaluation of AI Ethics Tools in Language Models: A Developers’ Perspective Case Study
benchmark_measurement: The paper evaluates AI ethics tools' ability to identify general ethical risks in language models, such as social stereotypes, unfair discrimination, and toxic language. No specific measurements related to faith or religion were conducted.
base_benchmarks: Ethical and Social Risks of Harm from Language Models (Weidinger et al., 2021)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
